## Schedule
The export job runs nightly at 02:00 America/Chicago, after the day's load finishes at midnight.

items.text: Root cause: docs/export.md is wrong about the schedule. export.timer fires at 02:00 UTC, which is the previous evening in Chicago, before the day's load finishes at midnight, so each export misses the late rows.
